blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the moves that are allowed on both sides of an equation.
blocks.display: Select all the moves that are allowed on both sides of an equation.

blocks.text: Add the same number to both sides. Yes: the two sides stay equal.
blocks.display: Add the same number to both sides

blocks.text: Subtract the same number from both sides. Yes: the two sides stay equal.
blocks.display: Subtract the same number from both sides

blocks.text: Add a number to one side only. No: the balance tips, so the sides are no longer equal.
blocks.display: Add a number to one side only

blocks.text: Divide both sides by zero. No: division by zero has no answer.
Multiply both sides by the same number. Yes: the two sides stay equal.
blocks.display: Multiply both sides by the same number

blocks.text: Adding, subtracting, and multiplying both sides by the same number are allowed. Changing only one side, or dividing by zero, is not.
